# Remove-ZbxProxyGroup

## SYNOPSIS

Removes proxy groups.

## SYNTAX

```
Remove-ZbxProxyGroup [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixProxyGroup>[]> [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A proxy group shares its hosts among its proxies and moves them to another proxy of the group when one goes offline (Zabbix 7.0 and later). The Remove-ZbxProxyGroup cmdlet deletes the proxy groups given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with proxygroup.delete, all in one call when the pipeline ends. It asks for confirmation first unless -Confirm:$false or -Force is given, and -WhatIf lists what would be deleted. It writes nothing, and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Delete a proxy group

```powershell
Remove-ZbxProxyGroup -InputObject 'proxy-group-01' -Confirm:$false
```

Deletes the proxy group proxy-group-01. -Confirm:$false skips the prompt the command shows by default.

### Example 2: Preview deleting the proxy groups a search finds

```powershell
Get-ZbxProxyGroup -Name 'proxy*' | Remove-ZbxProxyGroup -WhatIf
```

Lists the proxy groups whose names start with proxy that the command would delete, and deletes nothing.
